# Room reactions, edits, deletes and files (#4796, #4797, #4812)

Retention: retained as bounded review evidence for #4796, #4797 and #4812. Replace only with superseding reviewed evidence.

Images live on the orphan branch `pr-assets/room-message-actions-4796`, pinned at commit `e0e5b9b019e5`; `receipt.json` lists each file's SHA-256.

All frames come from one full local gallery run (198 screens, all captured) at `c41e1ce4484f`, the branch merged with `origin/main` `2ef7f1758d1e`, which includes #4809 (channels) and #4855 (sidebar and full-screen phone channels). Phone frames show #4855's full-screen channel page and thread page. The reactions, picker, edited, deleted and attachment scenes are new, so they have no before; `room-short`'s before is the same scene in main's gallery. Every PNG was opened. Local captures on an isolated e2e Station; not native shells or physical devices. Times follow the capturing host's time zone.

[Design sketch](design-sketch.md) written before implementation.
